title: NeMo Guardrails 发布 v0.24.0
description: What's Changed NeMo Guardrails 0.24.0 substantially expands the built-in rails available through IORails. IORails can now execute 59 of the library's 67 action-backed input and output surfaces, including community integrations and rails that transform content, while sharing the same underlying rail implementations with LLMRails.
